name: ShineGreymon: Burst Mode
xros_req:
[Burst Digivolve] [ShineGreymon]: By returning 1 [Marcus Damon] to hand, cost 0
At the end of the burst digivolution turn, trash this Digimon's top card.
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] from your hand without paying its cost. For the turn, treat the Tamer played with this effect as a 12000 DP Digimon with ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.), and it cannot digivolve.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Tamers becomes suspended, Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's security stack.
